description: This file provides utility functions for parsing Hanzi-Pinyin pairs and creating Markdown AST to HTML converters with specific handlers for Chinese and English text, including rendering Hanzi with pinyin as ruby elements.

methods.name: parseHanziPinyinPairs
methods.description: Parses Hanzi (Chinese characters) and Pinyin pairs from a given text string.

methods.name: createMdastToHtml
methods.description: Creates a function to convert Markdown AST to HTML with specific handlers based on language.
